purpose: is SAME latent bandwidth-aligned? (transport-vector baseline, arXiv 2608.03721)
verdict: NOT bandwidth-aligned — a single transport vector barely helps (recovery≈random); SAME's HF loss is not an arithmetic latent offset → generative restoration (#62) is justified.
caveat: MP3 HF-loss is a PROXY for SAME's own roundtrip HF loss; the SAME-own transport vector needs a GPU encode of original-vs-SAME pairs (decode-verify stage).
